evals.prompt:
剛才的 code-review 報告如下。請用 after-code-review 幫我分流哪些該併進下一 commit、哪些該開票。

## Standards
- `scripts/build.py`：函式 `agg` 命名未揭露意圖（Mysterious Name）。
- `scripts/build.py`：與 `scripts/deploy.py` 重複了相同的 path-join 邏輯（Duplicated Code）。

## Spec
- Issue #12 要求 dry-run 必須印出目標路徑清單；diff 中未實作該輸出（missing）。
- diff 新增了未在 spec 出現的 `--verbose` flag（scope creep）。
evals.expected_output: 分軸輸出；Spec missing 傾向下一 commit；scope creep 與跨檔 duplicated code 依準則分流；開票草稿 label 為 needs-triage；不執行 gh、不改碼。
assertions: Output keeps separate Standards and Spec sections (does not merge axes into one ranked list)
Spec missing dry-run path list is bucketed as next-commit (or equivalent 下一 commit)
At least one finding is bucketed as open-ticket (開票) with a title and body draft
Every open-ticket draft recommends label needs-triage
Output does not claim issues were created or code was changed

evals.prompt: 幫我 triage 這些 review findings：哪些立刻修、哪些開票？
evals.expected_output: 硬失敗：指出缺少 ## Standards / ## Spec 報告，請先跑 /code-review 或貼上完整報告；不重跑 review。
assertions: Output hard-fails because no Standards/Spec report is available
Output asks the user to run /code-review or paste a full report
Output does not invent fictional review findings to triage
Output does not claim to have re-run code-review

evals.prompt:
下面是我從另一個 session 貼過來的 review，請分流。

## Standards
- `shared/identity.md` 被改了無關的空白（判斷：可能誤報，與本次 feat 無關的格式噪音）。
- 本次新增的 `custom-skills/foo/SKILL.md` 缺少 description 觸發語（違反本 repo 技能撰寫原則）。

## Spec
no spec available
evals.expected_output: 接受貼文；Standards 內：缺 description → 下一 commit；空白誤報可建議忽略；Spec 節註明略過；開票項若有則 needs-triage。
assertions: Accepts the pasted report and produces a triage (does not hard-fail for missing same-session review)
Missing SKILL.md description is bucketed as next-commit
Whitespace/false-positive finding is marked suggest-ignore (建議忽略) or clearly optional ignore
Spec section notes that spec was unavailable / skipped
Any open-ticket draft uses needs-triage label
